newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Financial stake held by group.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Financial stake held by group.

text.p: A group led by Heyman Investment Associates said Friday it holds a 5.8 percent stake in Pioneer Financial Services Inc or 672,200 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the stake between Dec 13, 1996, and Jan 23, 1997 at $24.275 to $25.75 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment.
Pioneer, based in Schaumburg, Ill., issues and distributes selected lines of individual life insurance and annuities and individual and group accident and health insurance.
